summary: Pet, raise, and command a cute hamster of mass destruction in this defense TD!
description:
Nurture the cutest weapon of mass destruction at the end of the world.

MOCHI-O is an addictive, action-packed doomsday land defense adventure where you raise a suspiciously adorable furball to protect your nation from foreign invaders. 

Brought to you by zxima.LLC, the creator of the acclaimed "cozy apocalyptic" pixel-art titles like "Catastrophe Restaurant" and "Parasite Days."

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
◆ GAME FEATURES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【COMBAT】Grab Mochi-O and Blast Invaders!
Experience fast-paced, satisfying roguelite action. Wipe out waves of enemies to collect seeds, level up, and choose from random skill upgrades mid-battle. Maximize your fire rate, critical chance, and attack range. Unleash a chaotic arsenal—ranging from standard bullets and homing missiles to devastating orbital lasers!

【NURTURE】Flick Seeds & Bond with Your Weapon
Spend your hard-earned cash from battles to upgrade Mochi-O. Use a playful, coin-toss mechanic to flick pink sunflower seeds right into Mochi-O's mouth. Pet him, feed him, and decorate his room. As his trust and love for you grow, his battle stats reach terrifying, god-like levels!

【STORY】Charming Yet Unhinged Dialogue
You report to the Director, a captivating, eyepatch-wearing young girl who commands you from a remote monitor. Fail her, and you might end up sliced in half like the previous keeper! Enjoy a perfect balance of heartwarming banter, a dark-comedy apocalypse, and a deeply challenging endless mode.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
◆ RECOMMENDED FOR FANS OF:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
・Roguelite bullet-heaven games (like Vampire Survivors)
・Charming retro pixel art and indie games with a quirky twist
・Pet-raising simulations with high-stakes action gameplay
・Deeply replayable progression systems and over-the-top destruction

Become Mochi-O’s keeper today, brace the defense line, and save the world with your fluffy annihilation companion!
